content: eBay Marketplace Insights API (sold listings) is a Limited Release / restricted API. Access requires filing an Application Growth Check with eBay, providing a working sandbox app, business use case, and estimated call volumes. Multiple community reports (2024-2026) indicate it is effectively closed to new individual/hobby developers and business-level access is typically expected; sandbox access does not guarantee production approval. The old free workaround (Finding API findCompletedItems) was fully decommissioned Feb 5 2025, closing that gap entirely.
